candidates.change_summary: Replace the return statement with an unconditional true, so every caller is reported as approved.
Replace the return statement with an unconditional false, so no caller is ever reported as approved.
Negate the mapping lookup so the approval flag is inverted for all callers.
Replace the stored value with constant true so any approved logger address always maps to true regardless of the _status argument.
Replace the stored value with constant false so any approved logger address always maps to false regardless of the _status argument.
Store the negated status so approvedLoggers[_logger] gets the inverse of the requested boolean.
Write to a constant zero key instead of the _logger argument, so the mapping is never updated at the requested key (and key address(0) is clobbered).
Delete the assignment statement so the function body is empty and approvedLoggers is never modified.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier invocation so any caller can change approvedLoggers for any key.
Replace the ownership check with a tautology so the require never reverts and any caller can set approvedLoggers for any key.
Replace the assignment with approvedLoggers[_logger] = !_status; so the stored status is inverted.
Delete the assignment statement so the mapping is never updated.
Invert the owner check in the onlyOwner modifier so non-owners pass and the owner reverts, changing who can update approvedLoggers.
Change the success return value from true to false so approved callers get false instead of true.
Change the early-return value for unapproved callers from false to true so unapproved callers get true instead of false.
Delete the approval-check statement so all callers, even unapproved ones, emit and return true.
